name: Complexity-Aware Continuous Level of Detail for Gaussian Splatting
definition: A global, view-independent Level of Detail (LoD) formulation that provides a single primitive ordering whose prefixes define successive approximations, enabling progressive streaming by transmitting additional primitives as the budget increases.
summary: KoalaGS is a global, view-independent level-of-detail method for Gaussian Splatting that sorts primitives by complexity to enable progressive streaming and continuous budget adjustment without retraining.
